build_vision_tower: build a vision tower module using MetaMorphMetaModel with a given config and delay loading
encode_images: encode image tensors into feature embeddings using MetaMorphMetaForCausalLM encode_images method
prepare_multimodal_inputs: prepare multimodal input embeddings and labels for training using prepare_inputs_labels_for_multimodal
unpad_image: unpad a PyTorch image tensor to its original aspect ratio using unpad_image function
initialize_vision_tokenizer: initialize vision tokenizer with image patch and start end tokens using initialize_vision_tokenizer
